definitions.short: a poker (for turning or gathering embers)
definitions.full: H181. ud אוּד noun masculine brand, fire-brand (originally perhaps bent stick used to stir fire) ׳א מִשְּׂרֵפָה מֻצָּל Amos 4:11 = ׳א ׳מ מֵאֵשׁ Zech 3:2 , plural הָעֲשֵׁנִים הָאוּדִים זַנְבוֺת Isa 7:4 , stumps of smoking firebrands.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to rake together;
